evidence.orphan_cleanup_cypher: MATCH (n:Entity {group_id: $g}) WHERE NOT (n)<-[:MENTIONS]-(:Episodic) AND NOT (n)-[:RELATES_TO]-() WITH n LIMIT 1000 DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(n) AS removed

notes: remove_episode deletes: the Episodic node, edges whose FIRST episode is the removed one, and entities mentioned by no other episode. It does NOT: rewrite summaries/attributes on surviving entities (derived text survives), prune the removed episode uuid from other edges' .episodes (dangling refs), or protect an edge that a later episode also supports when the owner is removed. Orphan entities created outside episodes are never cleaned (platform Cypher drafted). clear_data(driver, [group]) purges one tenant cleanly. P8 deletion therefore = remove_episode for each source episode + re-summarise or delete surviving entities that cite the subject + prune dangling refs + orphan sweep + verification query, not remove_episode alone.
